---
description: "@navikt/aksel-icons: adding/updating SVG icons and metadata; generated React components."
applyTo: "@navikt/aksel-icons/**"
---

# aksel-icons

- Source: `icons/<Name>.svg` + `icons/<Name>.yml`. Every SVG has a matching YML and vice versa (checked by `__tests__/validate-files.test.ts`). Most icons also have a `<Name>Fill` variant.
- YML shape: copy a sibling, e.g. `icons/Airplane.yml` (`name`, `category`, `sub_category`, `keywords` (nb + en), `variant: Stroke|Fill`, `created_at: DD.MM.YYYY`).
- SVG root: `width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none"`. Shapes use `fill="#202733"` (becomes `currentColor` at build) and `stroke-width` 1.5 if any. `__tests__/validate-svg*.test.ts` enforces this. Copy a sibling SVG.
- `src/` React components, `dist/` and metadata are generated by `build` (SVGR). Never edit `src/` by hand.
- `core-icons/` is only used for the downloadable zip. `fetch-new:icons` pulls from Figma and needs a token. Don't run it unless asked.
- New icon = minor changeset for `@navikt/aksel-icons` (e.g. `Icons: New icons Timeline, TimelineFill`).
- Validate: `corepack yarn workspace @navikt/aksel-icons test`. Run `build` when checking generated output.
